package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
)

// scenario for bytes_splitaftern_two_index_one_cut: `bytes.SplitAfterN(..., 2)[1]` instead of a two-part `bytes.Cut(...)` flow.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario462Positive(data []byte, sep []byte) []byte {
	return bytes.SplitAfterN(data, sep, 2)[1]
}
